title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

1. Educação: Bacharelado ou superior em comércio internacional, gestão logística, comércio eletrônico ou áreas afins.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Predial
description:
RESUMO DO TRABALHO:

Realiza tarefas técnicas, elétricas e mecânicas, incluindo instalação, reparo, manutenção preventiva, solução de problemas e melhorias de processos em instalações existentes e futuras. Além disso, o técnico de manutenção trabalhará na conservação das áreas externas, áreas comuns e áreas de produção para manter o padrão da empresa de ambientes limpos e seguros.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Trabalhar com o Gerente de Manutenção para desenvolver cronogramas padrão de manutenção preventiva.

• Operar, reparar e manter equipamentos de produção, equipamentos de movimentação de materiais, sistemas elétricos e mecânicos, incluindo, mas não limitado a sistemas e equipamentos de sprinklers contra incêndio.

• Substituir peças defeituosas como engrenagens, embreagens, buchas, eixos, rolamentos, solenóides, válvulas, bombas, controles de direção, etc.

• Executar manutenção de rotina em todas as máquinas da planta e demais áreas do prédio e da propriedade conforme instruções do gerente de operações.

• Executar corretamente os procedimentos de Bloqueio e Etiquetagem (Lockout Tagout) e manter atenção constante à segurança.

• Utilizar ferramentas elétricas e manuais para realizar diversas tarefas, incluindo reparo de máquinas, montagem de tubulação, manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.

• Operar empilhadeiras, carrinhos e outros equipamentos básicos de carga e descarga, quando necessário.

• Fazer a lubrificação, engraxamento e abastecimento dos equipamentos conforme necessário.

• Completar procedimentos rotineiros de manutenção preventiva conforme estabelecido no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoiar programas de redução de custos e controle de despesas, priorizando consertar ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdícios de materiais e suprimentos, e utilizando corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos.


CONHECIMENTOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES BÁSICAS:

• Capacidade comprovada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para identificar e corrigir problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz.

• Habilidade para operar equipamentos básicos de escritório como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de postagem e sistemas telefônicos multilinha.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.


EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé, caminhar e/ou sentar por longos períodos, além de dobrar-se, agachar, subir escadas, alcançar, carregar objetos e rastejar em áreas confinadas.

• Deve ter capacidade para trabalhar em áreas internas e externas em todas as condições climáticas (chuva, neve, calor, granizo, vento e gelo).

• Deve ser capaz de empurrar, puxar, levantar, carregar ou manusear pesos de até 11 kg sozinho e até 23 kg com ajuda.

• Deve ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo sobreaviso durante noites, fins de semana e feriados.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.


Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.


Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.


Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • Primam pela excelência na execução como forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem um ambiente inclusivo e um bom clima tanto para as pessoas que trabalham no Meli como para o negócio.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.

  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate


São Paulo, Brazil

About Divibank:


At Divibank, we are developing the leading platform for online businesses in Latin America, combining

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.


This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.


About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the processes of proposal generation, KYC (Know Your Customer), and client

onboarding, ensuring agility and clear communication with all relevant teams.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, ensuring an efficient onboarding process,

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

  • Oversee customer support operations using CX tools to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

  • Monitor transaction data and chargebacks, quickly identifying fraud risks and implementing

corrective actions.

  • Handle chargeback response cases, supporting clients to timely respond with the necessary

information.

  • Work together with our Treasury to ensure client settlements are working according to plan.
  • Run credit card receivable assignment operations, either for discounting or for collection

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Map and review operational workflows and data to identify gaps and propose improvements,

whether through process adjustments, the implementation of third-party tools, or development

suggestions for internal product and tech teams.

  • Collaborate with technology and product teams to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in

a timely manner.

  • Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs and ensure their satisfaction with

our services.

  • Work closely with the sales and product teams to align customer success initiatives to optimize

customer journey

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.


What qualifications we need:

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, customer success, or a related role, preferably within the

fintech, payments or consulting industries.

  • Bachelor’s degree (completed or in progress) in relevant fields (Business Administration,

Engineering, etc.).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) and operations tools.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and business orientation
  • Positive, willing to get hands dirty and proactive attitude
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize in ambiguous situations
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in English (verbal and written)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience in Fintech or online Payments industry
  • Basic understanding of APIs or technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineers
  • Knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Looker.


Personal attitudes we look for:

  • You get sh*t done!
  • You do whatever it takes to get things moving and completed
  • You have an ownership mentality, are energetic, and bring the best out of others
  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences
  • Everyone understands what your priorities and objectives are
  • You organize and break down complex problems into simple tasks
  • You can think structurally and identify bottlenecks
  • You balance and align your short and long-term priorities with Divibank’s goals
  • You are curious and have a growth mindset
  • You are always learning and growing (even outside of work)
  • You take risks, learn from failures quickly and apply lessons learned
  • You are quietly confident and openly humble
  • You are confident in your abilities, and are not afraid to step up when needed
  • You respect the backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking of others


Key Benefits:

  • Amil Health and dental insurances
  • Competitive salary
  • Chance of earning equity at Divibank
  • Flexible paid vacation
  • Totalpass

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager – BU Manager , you will act as the driving force behind our expansion in Brazil.

You’ll be responsible for building our market presence, developing a portfolio of strategic clients, and leading a team of Junior Business Developers. Your mission is to scale revenue, establish LittleBig as a key player in Brazil, and ensure operational excellence across all activities.


Key Responsibilities

Market Launch & Strategic Growth

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for Brazil
  • Open and grow strategic accounts in targeted industries
  • Adapt LittleBig’s value proposition to local market needs and positioning


Client Development & Key Account Management

  • Drive acquisition of major enterprise clients and expand relationships with existing customers
  • Lead the full commercial cycle: prospecting, RFP responses, proposal creation, and complex negotiations
  • Represent LittleBig at the highest level with C-level and procurement stakeholders


BU Leadership & Team Management

  • Hire, coach, and manage a local team of Junior Business Developers
  • Set performance targets and lead the team to achieve collective goals
  • Instill a high-performance, collaborative, and ownership-driven culture


Talent Network Development & Delivery Oversight

  • Build a local community of freelancers and consulting firms
  • Oversee expert-client matching and mission delivery quality
  • Ensure successful execution from contracting to delivery, supported by internal teams


Performance Tracking & Governance

  • Monitor KPIs: revenue, margin, project pipeline, closing rates, team performance
  • Deliver regular reports and business insights to global leadership
  • Ensure full compliance with legal, financial, and operational standards



Profile

  • Master’s degree from a top business school, engineering school, or university
  • 3 to 7 years of experience in B2B business development, consulting, or strategic sales, ideally in international or digital environments
  • Proven track record in market development and client acquisition
  • Strong leadership skills and experience in managing high-performing teams
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability; data- and result-driven
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; French is a plus
  • Solid knowledge of digital tools and B2B sales practices (CRM, automation, AI)

title: Product Owner - Wholesale Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Close to clients.

Due to our continued growth, we are looking for a passionate and experienced Product Owner / Senior to join our team in São Paulo (hybrid model).

If you’re excited about leading Agile projects, managing backlogs, and aligning business goals with technology delivery, this is the place for you!


What will you do?

  • Define product scope and elaborate detailed requirements.
  • Write user stories and estimate the resources needed by the development team.
  • Coordinate and manage sprint planning meetings and backlog grooming.
  • Work closely with developers to clarify doubts and prioritize demands.
  • Monitor homologations and pilot phases.
  • Prepare and follow up on project schedules, status reports, and control routines.
  • Ensure on-time deliveries and project milestones.
  • Identify risks, escalate when necessary, and propose mitigation plans.


What are we looking for?


Must Have

  • Minimum 3 years of recent experience as a Product Owner or similar role.
  • Languages: Professional proficiency in English and/or Spanish.
  • Methodologies: Solid experience with Agile frameworks.
  • Certifications: CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) or PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner).
  • Strong project management skills and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Proactive problem-solving, ability to independently gather information and confidently engage with project stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Treasury products (e.g., Fixed Income, Derivatives, Trade Finance).
  • Knowledge of Global/Capital Markets.
  • Familiarity with Jira Software.
  • Experience designing process workflows and end-to-end product journeys.
  • Ability to evaluate new products considering legal, tax, operational, and financial dimensions.
  • Strong data-driven decision making: able to define KPIs, interpret analytics, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Advanced English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in business modeling and understanding the full product lifecycle impact.
  • Previous experience in international or multicultural environments , adapting product and communication to diverse markets.
  • Familiarity with system integration, APIs, and service-oriented architecture (SOA / micro-services).
  • Spanish is a Plus


What do we offer?

  • The opportunity to work in an international environment with potential mobility across global offices.
  • Continuous learning and development , with access to official certifications.
  • Language classes to support your global career.
  • A tailored career development plan with mentorship and merit-based growth.
  • Dynamic and flexible work environment.
  • Internal initiatives such as sports, trips, and corporate events.

CLT contract model, including:

  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Transportation allowance.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.


*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding “Leis de incentivo”

title: Secretária administrativa
description:
Vaga: Secretária Administrativa

Resumo do cargo

A pessoa que ocupar esta função será responsável por oferecer suporte administrativo e operacional a diferentes áreas da organização, garantindo que as atividades do dia a dia fluam de forma eficiente e organizada. Atuará como ponto de apoio entre a equipe, a direção e o público externo, contribuindo para o bom andamento das rotinas e o alcance dos objetivos institucionais.

Como ter sucesso neste cargo

Para ter sucesso nesta posição, é essencial demonstrar proatividade, discrição, atenção aos detalhes e excelente capacidade de comunicação. A pessoa ideal saberá priorizar demandas, manter a confidencialidade de informações estratégicas e apresentar postura colaborativa. O sucesso será medido pela capacidade de manter a estrutura administrativa fluindo de forma organizada e pelo apoio efetivo às lideranças e equipes.

Como este cargo se encaixa na organização

A função de Secretária Administrativa é fundamental para a integração dos processos internos, servindo como elo entre diferentes setores. Essa posição garante a eficiência das operações diárias e contribui diretamente para que a gestão mantenha foco nas decisões estratégicas, sabendo que as rotinas administrativas estão sob controle.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar agendas, compromissos e reuniões, assegurando organização e pontualidade.
  • Elaborar, revisar e arquivar documentos administrativos e correspondências oficiais.
  • Atender e direcionar comunicações internas e externas, com clareza e cordialidade.
  • Apoiar o controle de despesas, elaboração de relatórios e acompanhamento de pagamentos.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de gestão na preparação de apresentações, relatórios e eventos corporativos.
  • Manter o controle de materiais de escritório e suprimentos, garantindo o bom funcionamento do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Apoiar processos de recrutamento, integração de novos colaboradores e gestão de registros administrativos.
  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações e pelo cumprimento das políticas internas da organização.
Qualificações
  • Formação técnica ou superior em Administração, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou de secretariado.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e ferramentas de comunicação digital.
  • Competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com atenção à clareza e à formalidade adequada.
  • Capacidade de organização, planejamento e gestão do tempo.
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente e resolver problemas de forma autônoma.
  • Postura ética, profissional e colaborativa em todas as interações.

Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.

  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations

  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps

title: Executivo comercial
description:
Buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) Comercial com perfil estratégico, analítico e orientado a resultados para liderar a frente de vendas de soluções tecnológicas e produtos digitais.

Essa posição tem papel essencial na estruturação, gestão e expansão do funil de vendas , bem como na liderança do time comercial , garantindo a performance e o crescimento sustentável do portfólio de produtos de compliance, PLD/FT, governança e integridade corporativa.

O(a) profissional atuará de forma transversal com as áreas de marketing, produtos, tecnologia e comunicação institucional, com foco em gerar novos negócios, fortalecer relacionamentos estratégicos e consolidar a presença da marca no mercado nacional e internacional.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Liderar o time comercial (executivos de contas, hunters, SDRs e inside sales), definindo metas, planos de ação e indicadores de performance.
  • Estruturar e otimizar o funil de vendas , desde a prospecção até o fechamento e pós-venda, utilizando metodologias modernas de CRM e pipeline (Salesforce, RD Station, Pipedrive, etc.).
  • Atuar diretamente na prospecção e relacionamento com grandes contas , incluindo corporações, instituições financeiras, escritórios de advocacia, órgãos públicos e parceiros internacionais.
  • Elaborar e executar estratégias de Go-To-Market (GTM) para os produtos e plataformas do grupo.
  • Conduzir negociações complexas e contratuais , com visão de margem, precificação e modelo de recorrência (SaaS / licenciamento).
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com o Marketing e o time de Produto , garantindo coerência entre discurso comercial, posicionamento institucional e campanhas de geração de demanda.
  • Monitorar indicadores de conversão e desempenho , assegurando previsibilidade e escalabilidade da operação comercial.
  • Desenvolver relatórios executivos de performance comercial , apresentando resultados, previsões de receita e oportunidades à Diretoria Executiva.
  • Capacitar e inspirar o time de vendas , promovendo uma cultura de alta performance, aprendizado contínuo e engajamento.
  • Representar o grupo em eventos, feiras e fóruns nacionais e internacionais , fortalecendo a rede de relacionamentos institucionais e comerciais.


Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de times comerciais B2B , preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS, compliance, fintechs ou consultorias.
  • Histórico de estruturação de funil de vendas e metodologias comerciais (SPIN, Challenger, Sandler, MEDDIC, etc.).
  • Forte habilidade em negociação estratégica, gestão de carteira e prospecção consultiva .
  • Conhecimento em gestão de pipeline e uso de CRM , com leitura analítica de indicadores (CAC, LTV, churn, taxa de conversão, etc.).
  • Perfil empreendedor, resiliente e orientado a metas , com pensamento estratégico e foco em execução.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de articulação em níveis executivos e institucionais.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Negócios ou Marketing será considerado um diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado e vivência em negociações internacionais são diferenciais importantes.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Job Responsibilities:As a key member of the local Human Resources team, you will be responsible for executing day-to-day HR operations with accuracy and compliance. This role ensures smooth employee lifecycle management and supports a positive employee experience.

1.Employee Onboarding & Offboarding:Manage end-to-end new hire onboarding, including document collection, system entry, and orientation coordination.Process employee resignations and terminations, conduct exit interviews, complete clearance procedures, and maintain accurate records in compliance with CLT regulations.

2.Employment Contract Management:Prepare, issue, renew, and archive employment contracts in accordance with Brazilian labor laws (CLT).Track probation periods and support performance evaluation processes.

3.Attendance & Timekeeping Administration:Monitor daily attendance using electronic time clock systems (e.g., Ponto Eletrônico). Review overtime, absences, leaves, and schedule adjustments. Collaborate with department heads to validate monthly attendance data.

4.Payroll Support & Social Contributions:Assist in monthly payroll processing, including calculation of salaries, bonuses, deductions, and overtime.Handle statutory contributions such as FGTS, INSS, and IRRF — ensuring accurate reporting and timely payments.Coordinate with internal finance or external payroll providers to ensure error-free disbursement.

5.New Employee Orientation:Deliver basic onboarding training sessions covering company policies, workplace rules, HR systems, and safety guidelines.Support new hires in integrating into the team and understanding their roles.

6.HR Data & Record Keeping:Maintain up-to-date employee master data, personnel files, and HR databases.Ensure confidentiality and compliance in all HR documentation and system entries.


Qualifications & Requirements:

1.Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

2.Minimum 2 years of hands-on HR experience in a Brazilian company or multinational environment.

3.Solid understanding of Brazilian labor legislation (Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho – CLT).

4.Employee onboarding and offboarding.Employment contract administration.Attendance tracking and timekeeping systems (e.g., TOTVS, Senior, Oracle, etc.).Payroll support and social tax/filing (INSS, FGTS, IRRF)

5.Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable with strong execution skills.

6.Experience in conducting training or employee engagement activities.

7.Fluently English for business communication.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.



Key Responsibilities


  • Lead intuitive UX design:  Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy:  Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight:  Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping:  Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership:  Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders:  Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership:  Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing:  Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards:  Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.



Qualifications & Skills


  • Experience:  5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio:  An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge:  Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise:  Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems:  Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration:  Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset:  Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language:  Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Arquiteto de Domínio de Segurança Cibernética , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir, governar e evoluir modelos e padrões de arquitetura de segurança cibernética, alinhando frameworks globais (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT) às necessidades específicas das operações do cliente.
  • Liderar projetos e iniciativas de arquitetura de segurança para ambientes multi nuvem, locais, de rede, aplicativos, IoT/IIoT industrial, dados e mobilidade.
  • Projete soluções para prevenção, detecção, contenção e remediação de ameaças, integrando SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IAM e sistemas avançados de criptografia.
  • Atuo na definição de políticas e controles de identidade e acesso (IAM, SSO, MFA), segmentação de rede, proteção de endpoints, gestão de vulnerabilidades e governança.
  • Promova a integração entre as equipes de segurança física, TI, OT e operações para criar ambientes resilientes e seguros.
  • Desenvolva e valide estratégias de continuidade de negócios, recuperação de desastres cibernéticos e resposta a incidentes.
  • Avalie e implemente soluções de segurança inovadoras (Zero Trust, Cloud Security Posture Management, Threat Intelligence, automação e orquestração de segurança).
  • Garantir a conformidade com as leis e regulamentos de proteção de dados dos países onde opera (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica, planos de segurança, guias de melhores práticas e treinamento para equipes internas.
  • Participe de comunidades técnicas, fóruns, auditorias e avaliações globais de conformidade.


Competências Técnicas:

  • Profundo conhecimento em frameworks de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT, ITIL).

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?


IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.


Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?


In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


Here's what you can expect on a typical day:


  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fazer o planejamento anual dos shoppings para definição das prioridades estratégicas (principais oportunidades e desafios), diagnóstico do mix ideal de lojas, mapeamento de marcas (considerando posicionamento, faixa etária e estilo) e vocação, sempre alinhadas com as principais tendências globais e que possuem sinergia com o nosso negócio;

Avaliar a exposição em ABL, receita e vendas para marcas internacionais nos shoppings únicos (Iguatemi São Paulo, JK e Brasília) e garantir o melhor equilibrio nos contratos comerciais.

Definir vocação, mix ideal e planejar as lojas por categoria e segmento dos greenfields e expansões, além de elaborar junto com a arquitetura e engenharia as plantas e acompanhar / comercializar as lojas junto com a área comercial.

Realizar reuniões frequentes (aquecimento de lead) com lojistas para garantir gestão do portfólio e melhores negociações comerciais (leasing spread positivo, coparticipação, exclusividade, etc).

Realizar a curadoria de marcas para o Iguatemi 365 e garantir equilíbrio no mix de produtos dentro de suas categorias.

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.


More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.


Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.
